answer: Incident rule, assume the reviewer is bought. Stake every review, spot-check one in ten, slash the reviewer when a check fails, and put a fresh nonce on each submission so an old approval cannot be replayed. The forge of a bought verdict is simple, skim the stake, and that is the part the slash takes back. A farm must keep reviewers honest across a bridge of epochs, and each failure leaves an umber mark in the public log.
